newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks bounce back to end higher.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks bounce back to end higher.

text.p: Madrid stock indices reversed early losses to end slightly higher on Thursday, but dealers said the market was still not revealing any clear direction for the short-term.
The general index ended 2.75 points, 0.59 pct, higher at 472.43, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares rose 36.51 points, or 0.68 pct, to 5,415.50
"This afternoon funds were flowing into stocks like Telefonica and Endesa boosting the indices, but in the short term the market still is not showing any clear direction," one dealer said.
Dealers said turnover had picked up during the session with over 70 billion pesetas changing hands.
Dealers said a firmer peseta and strength in the bond market had also supported stocks.
Among individual stocks, Telefonica rose 45 pesetas to 3,370, while Endesa gained 170 pesetas to 9,350.
